scope: Bayesian HIL Top-K conditions excluding K=1
notes: Terminal does not mean every condition passed.
DGA has no successful HIL trials because every non-K=1 DGA condition exceeded the timing cap.
The collaborative portion of campaign V8 is incomplete and is not included in this publication.

files.name: bayesian_hil_topk_non_k1_condition_aggregate_metrics.csv
files.description: One row per terminal non-K=1 Bayesian HIL condition with status, stop reason, planned/completed/failed trial counts, timing distributions, and provenance hashes.

files.name: bayesian_hil_topk_non_k1_combined_trial_level_system_and_timing_results.csv
files.description: Canonical combined HIL analysis CSV with one row per successful system trial, including team steps, maximum robot steps, allocator and filter timing, call classifications, and provenance.

files.name: bayesian_hil_topk_non_k1_robot_trial_timing_and_allocator_metrics.csv
files.description: Four device-level robot rows per successful system trial with per-robot allocator and candidate-filter timing.

files.name: bayesian_hil_topk_non_k1_failed_trial_log.csv
files.description: Complete log of three Bayesian HIL trial failures with failure reasons and watchdog diagnostics.

files.name: bayesian_hil_topk_non_k1_watchdog_threshold_adjustment_log.csv
files.description: One HIPC repeated-state watchdog threshold adjustment recorded during the Bayesian HIL segment.

files.name: bayesian_hil_topk_non_k1_dataset_verification_manifest.json
files.description: Original Bayesian-only report manifest with source report counts, checksums, and arithmetic verification checks.
